messages:
Elena: Quick pulse 1: the weekly KPI board spiked sessions after the launch posts but MQLs barely moved. Can we triage before the Monday review?
Marcus: I pulled a top-level view 1: sessions +24% week-over-week, leads +6%, MQLs +1. That gap screams attribution fragmentation or form timing.
Rhea: We swapped the long-form to the lightweight CTA for social posts on Friday. Short form delays MQL signal until nurture step. Could explain low immediate MQLs.
Derek (ops): Also deployed a small spam-filter tweak at 2026-04-03 02:15 UTC that changes how duplicate submits are deduped. Might reduce raw leads but improve quality.
MetricBot: Quick stat run: landing=launch-compact had 4.1k sessions, 68 leads, 2 MQLs; landing=hero-full had 11.2k sessions, 290 leads, 38 MQLs.
Elena: Nice, so hero-full still driving MQLs. Action items: Rhea to produce a short cohort showing registration->MQL lag by form variant, Marcus to reconcile UTM/referrer splits (esp partner redirects), Derek to annotate the KPI board with the spam-filter deploy.
Rhea: Will have cohort table by Monday 08:30 PT and will highlight the median time-to-mql for each template.
Marcus: I'll run attribution reconciliation and flag utm_missing rows; expect a CSV by EOD Monday.
Derek (ops): Added dashboard annotation: "2026-04-03 spam-filter/dedupe change and social CTA variant swap may affect week-over-week raw leads."
Elena: Perfect. Also, let's add a one-line note in the KPI review explaining form-dependent timing so stakeholders don't overreact to the raw MQL delta.
Rhea: I'll draft that blurb.
Marcus: If anything else turns up I'll ping here. Closing for now. :thumbsup:
